verdict.rationale: Fern Agent can be scheduled to autonomously review reader feedback, unanswered questions, search queries, or analytics, and open a PR when it finds an issue — a genuine background automation loop (fern-docs-8/25, fern-docs-29). However this is scoped narrowly to docs-maintenance tasks rather than a general-purpose automation/agent platform, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the scheduler working beyond first-party changelog claims. Missing for 10: broader automation triggers beyond docs feedback loops, independent verification of the scheduling feature actually running unattended, and documentation of failure handling/monitoring for these background runs.
